finding.statement: The repair for the step broken by FC-REV0156-COMPOSED-NEVER-SIMPLY-BRANCHED does not need simple branching at all. For a finite morphism gamma : C -> P^1 of degree d from a smooth projective curve of genus g over an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero, with the target held fixed, the map T_C -> gamma^*T_{P^1} of line bundles is injective, so the Hurwitz normal sheaf N_gamma = coker(T_C -> gamma^*T_{P^1}) is TORSION, supported on the ramification divisor, of length deg(gamma^*T_{P^1}) - deg(T_C) = 2d + 2g - 2, independently of the ramification profile. A torsion sheaf on a curve has vanishing H^1, so H^1(N_gamma) = 0 for EVERY such gamma, the fixed-target Hurwitz deformation functor is unobstructed with tangent space H^0(N_gamma), and the fixed-target Hurwitz stack of degree-d genus-g covers is smooth of dimension 2d + 2g - 2 at every point, whatever the branching. For (d,g) = (4,6) this dimension is 18.
